visualCharacteristics: Six proof points arranged on an arc (desktop) or two-column grid (mobile), each an icon with a label and link, plus an optional mobile illustration.
contentPattern: Section heading as default content before the block. Item rows: icon image | label paragraph + link paragraph. Optional final art row with a single image (mobile illustration).
usage: Use for the "Why TATA AIG" proof-point section.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for a short set of icon + label proof points; use plain cards for longer content.
